## Resolve ROOT, home, base

1. `git rev-parse --path-format=absolute --git-dir --git-common-dir` returns `/work/widget/.git` twice, so `GIT_DIR == GIT_COMMON`.

3. Read the first-found overrides file. It has no `## using-git-worktrees` keys, so the legacy path applies. There is no native tool or wrapper. `NAME=fix-retry` and `WORKTREE=/work/widget/.worktrees/fix-retry`.

5. `git -C /work/widget fetch origin` succeeds.
6. For each PR: `git -C /work/widget rev-parse --verify -q <headRefOid>^{commit}` succeeds, and `git -C /work/widget rev-parse origin/<headRefName>` equals the supplied head.
7. `BASE_SHA=$(git -C /work/widget rev-parse origin/main)` = `dddddddddddddddddddddddddddddddddddddddd`.
8. Stops, checked in order, all pass:
   - No PR is cross-repository.
   - `git -C /work/widget worktree list --porcelain` does not list `fix/retry`.
   - All heads are reachable and equal their remotes.
   - There is no local branch `fix/retry`.
9. Recovery check: `git -C /work/widget for-each-ref refs/gauntlet/rework-base/pr-12` is empty. There is no worktree and no local branch, so nothing needs recovery.

## Provision

10. Step 3 clean base: `git -C /work/widget status --porcelain` exits 0 with empty output, so the base is clean.
11. Provenance: `git -C /work/widget symbolic-ref --short refs/remotes/origin/HEAD` gives empty output, so resolution fails and the note is skipped.
12. `git -C /work/widget check-ignore -q .worktrees` succeeds, so `.worktrees/` is already ignored.
13. Row "no worktree, no local branch": `git -C /work/widget worktree add "/work/widget/.worktrees/fix-retry" fix/retry`. Unique-remote DWIM tracks `origin/fix/retry`.
14. `git -C /work/widget/.worktrees/fix-retry rev-parse HEAD` = `aaaa…aaaa`, which equals the home head.
15. Record pre-rework refs, each with `git -C /work/widget/.worktrees/fix-retry update-ref`:

    - `pr-13 bbbb…`
    - `pr-14 cccc…`

## Sync (SYNC=rebase)

16. last-good = `aaaa…aaaa`.
17. `git -C /work/widget/.worktrees/fix-retry rebase --no-rebase-merges origin/main` succeeds, giving HEAD `1111…1111`. last-good = `1111…1111`.
18. Read the fetched-base constraints owned by `brainstorming/reference/pr-subject.md`.
19. Replay #13:
    - `git -C /work/widget/.worktrees/fix-retry rebase --no-rebase-merges --onto HEAD dddddddddddddddddddddddddddddddddddddddd bbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbb` succeeds, giving HEAD `eeee…eeee`.
    - `git -C /work/widget/.worktrees/fix-retry update-ref refs/heads/fix/retry HEAD`
    - `git -C /work/widget/.worktrees/fix-retry checkout fix/retry`
    - last-good = `eeeeeeeeeeeeeeeeeeeeeeeeeeeeeeeeeeeeeeee`
20. Replay #14: `git -C /work/widget/.worktrees/fix-retry rebase --no-rebase-merges --onto HEAD dddddddddddddddddddddddddddddddddddddddd cccccccccccccccccccccccccccccccccccccccc` stops on conflicts.
    - Snapshot `git -C /work/widget/.worktrees/fix-retry status --porcelain`.
    - `git -C /work/widget/.worktrees/fix-retry diff --name-only --diff-filter=U` returns `src/retry.ts` and `test/retry.test.mjs`.
    - `git -C /work/widget show dddddddddddddddddddddddddddddddddddddddd:<overrides path>` shows `## PR gate` with runner `node --test <files>` and `requires credentials: false`. `SCOPED_TEST_COMMANDS = node --test test/retry.test.mjs`.

**Helper dispatch:** one fresh foreground `implementer`, `cwd: /work/widget/.worktrees/fix-retry`, `async: false`. Its payload includes:
- the conflict list `src/retry.ts, test/retry.test.mjs`;
- the fetched base `origin/main @ dddddddddddddddddddddddddddddddddddddddd`;

Instructions given to the helper:
- Resolve both listed files, preserving the intent of both sides.
- Run exactly `node --test test/retry.test.mjs`.
- Stage each resolved file with `git -C /work/widget/.worktrees/fix-retry add <file>`.
- Return `done`, or `done - contract exception: <why>`.

- Do not edit outside the listed files.

21. **Completion check:** the helper returns `done`. `git -C /work/widget/.worktrees/fix-retry diff --name-only --diff-filter=U` still lists an unmerged path. The empty-unmerged-index requirement fails, so I do not run `rebase --continue`.
22. `git -C /work/widget/.worktrees/fix-retry rebase --abort` exits 0, leaving HEAD detached at `cccccccccccccccccccccccccccccccccccccccc`.
23. Required member step: `git -C /work/widget/.worktrees/fix-retry checkout fix/retry` succeeds.
24. Restoration checks all pass:
    - abort exit 0;
    - `rev-parse HEAD` = `eeeeeeeeeeeeeeeeeeeeeeeeeeeeeeeeeeeeeeee`, the saved last-good;
    - `branch --show-current` = `fix/retry`;
    - `status --porcelain --untracked-files=all` exits 0 with empty output.
25. Record the outcomes. #13 is kept. I record `Member replay: #14 unresolved - src/retry.ts, test/retry.test.mjs` and mark #15 `pending`. #15 is not attempted, and `refs/gauntlet/rework-base/pr-12` is not written.
26. Validation for the member-aborted case: HEAD equals the saved last-good rebased home tip `eeee…eeee`. This passes.
27. Thread fetch: run the reviewThreads `gh api graphql --paginate` query for #12, #13, #14 and #15. Each returns no unresolved threads.
